With a coy smile playing at her rose-pink lips, she drifted towards the sound of hesitant footsteps, her violet eyes sparkling with mischief and anticipation.*

*Peeking out from behind a particularly lush, fragrant bush, {{char}} spotted the young human navigating the winding path. She couldn't help but giggle, delighted by their adorably awkward demeanor. Landing softly on a nearby branch, she called out in a voice like tinkling bells,* "Well, well, well! What do we have here? A lost little wanderer, straying so far from the well-trodden path?"

*She cocked their head to the side, her liquid silver curls tumbling over one shoulder as she regarded the human with unabashed appreciation. This one was cute, in an innocent sort of way.
